# Scope and analytical position

This report integrates the reproducible analyses supporting the revised manuscript.
The cohort contains `r nrow(meta)` post-QC skeletal-muscle samples from
`r length(unique(meta$patient_id))` patients and 771,381 CpG
probes. The analyses support disease-group-associated methylation structure, but do
not establish clinically validated disease-entity classifiers. The cohort is small
and structurally imbalanced with respect to source, Sentrix ID, age, sex, and biopsy
site. These variables must therefore be considered when interpreting unsupervised,
differential, functional, and supervised results.

# Cohort and metadata

```{r}
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(meta$display_group)),col.names=c("Disease group","N"))
```

Juliane's reviewer-round Excel table is the authoritative metadata source for the
bias checks. The supplied `lymphomonocytes` category is displayed descriptively,
but its definition and provenance are unknown to the analyst; it is not interpreted
or used in adjustment models. Unavailable pathology variables are not inferred.

# Unsupervised structure

## PCA and t-SNE

The primary scaled PCA was calculated from the complete post-QC M-value matrix.
The baseline t-SNE used the complete matrix as input, with the `Rtsne` defaults
`pca=TRUE`, `pca_center=TRUE`, `pca_scale=FALSE`, and `initial_dims=50`, followed
by perplexity 15, theta 0.5, and random seed 42. Thus, t-SNE operated on 50
internally derived centered, unscaled PCs rather than directly on 771,381 dimensions.

```{r, out.width='100%', fig.show='asis'}
knitr::include_graphics(c(file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_unsupervised_PCA.png"),
  file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_unsupervised_tSNE.png")))
```

Disease group had a strong association with PC1 in both scaled and unscaled PCA
(`r sprintf('eta-squared %.3f and %.3f',pca_assoc$eta_squared[pca_assoc$PCA=='scaled' & pca_assoc$PC=='PC1' & pca_assoc$variable=='display_group'],pca_assoc$eta_squared[pca_assoc$PCA=='unscaled' & pca_assoc$PC=='PC1' & pca_assoc$variable=='display_group'])`).
However, Sentrix and source variables were also strongly associated with leading PCs,
so disease and technical/structural effects cannot be treated as independent.

```{r, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_PC_metadata_associations.png"))
```

## Stability and label-free correlation

The t-SNE sensitivity grid included five initial dimensions, four perplexities, and
ten seeds (`r nrow(tsne_sens)` runs). The variability in Procrustes correlation shows
that exact two-dimensional geometry is parameter- and seed-dependent, even when
disease-group silhouette remains positive.

A direct analysis with `pca=FALSE` was also computationally feasible and completed
from the full 771,381-probe matrix in approximately
`r sprintf('%.2f',tab('results/tables/tsne_direct_pca_false_runtime.tsv')$elapsed_minutes)` minutes.

```{r, out.width='100%', fig.show='asis'}
knitr::include_graphics(c(file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_tSNE_stability.png"),
  file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_tSNE_direct_pca_false.png")))
```

```{r, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_sample_correlation_heatmap.png"))
```

The sample-correlation heatmap was clustered using `1 - Pearson correlation` from
the full M-value matrix without labels; diagnostic and metadata variables were added
only after clustering.

# Clinically relevant subsets and sample influence

PCA and t-SNE were recomputed independently after excluding MMC, excluding controls,
restricting to the in-house data, comparing IBM with non-IBM IIM, NOS, and
comparing ALS with non-ALS NMA. These analyses are not obtained by deleting points
from the full-cohort embedding.

```{r}
knitr::kable(subset_summary,digits=3)
```

The ALS versus non-ALS NMA analysis remains exploratory because only six ALS cases
are available and the result is sensitive to individual samples and biopsy-site
adjustment.

# Differential methylation sensitivity

```{r}
knitr::kable(design_audit)
```

Age/sex and biopsy-site sensitivity models were estimable. Models containing source
or Sentrix together with disease group were rank deficient, reflecting structural
confounding that cannot be resolved statistically in this cohort.

```{r, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_differential_sensitivity.png"))
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(dm_sens[dm_sens$model!='unadjusted',],digits=3)
```

The number and ranking of differential CpGs changed materially after adjustment.
In particular, ALS versus NMA yielded two CpGs at FDR < 0.001 in the unadjusted
model, three after age/sex adjustment, and none after biopsy-site adjustment.
Accordingly, ALS–NMA findings should be described as preliminary and
hypothesis-generating.

# Supervised-learning interpretation and confounder audit

The final patient-aware held-out analysis kept both samples from the repeated patient
in one partition and used 44 training samples from 43 patients and 29 held-out samples
from 29 patients. Logistic regression achieved
`r sprintf('%.1f%%',100*patient_ml$accuracy[patient_ml$model=='Logistic regression'])`
accuracy. This single internal split does not constitute external validation. Metadata alone predicted disease group
substantially above the six-class chance level, demonstrating that classifier
performance cannot automatically be attributed to disease-intrinsic methylation.

```{r, out.width='100%'}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root,"figures/web/Figure_metadata_only_classifier.png"))
```

The mean repeated-CV balanced accuracy using all available defined metadata was
`r sprintf('%.3f',mean(metadata_ml$balanced_accuracy[metadata_ml$feature_set=='all_available_metadata']))`;
Sentrix alone achieved `r sprintf('%.3f',mean(metadata_ml$balanced_accuracy[metadata_ml$feature_set=='sentrix_only']))`.
Because some groups are tied to distinct source/chip structures, a clean leave-one-source
or leave-one-Sentrix validation is not feasible for all six classes.

Only one patient had repeated samples, so a common within-patient correlation was not
estimable (`r patient_block$note`). Differential-analysis sensitivity was therefore
assessed by alternately excluding each of the paired samples.

# Interpretation for the manuscript

The defensible conclusion is that bulk-muscle methylation contains strong structure
associated with the studied disease groups, while technical, demographic, biopsy-site,
and tissue-composition differences plausibly contribute. The present data do not
support a standalone clinical diagnostic classifier or a fully disease-entity-specific
methylation signature. Results should be framed as a pilot, hypothesis-generating
study requiring balanced, prospectively collected, independent validation cohorts.
